reason: The cloud lies directly across the jet, so their encounter should show how the narrow stream disturbs surrounding gas.
expectation: The jet will shock or push the cloud, perhaps producing a broader disturbance.

alternatives.reason: Following the jet through thin gas also seems relevant, but the cloud collision looks more direct.

effect: The jet has heated and fragmented the cloud; I can now follow how that disturbed gas affects its surroundings.
reaction: The loss of an immediate chance for star formation makes the collision consequential.
reason: Mixing the broken cloud with surrounding gas seems the most direct way to follow the widening disturbance.
expectation: The hot fragments may heat or push the surrounding gas, spreading the disturbance.

alternatives.reason: Following the jet through thin gas is also relevant, but I want to trace the cloud collision first.

effect: The broken cloud expanded into a broad hot cavity, completing the disturbance goal; I can now follow its effect on cold clouds.
reaction: The narrow jet producing a wide cavity is a satisfying contrast.
reason: The cavity and cold clouds directly address whether outward-carried cold gas remains in the galaxy.
expectation: The expanding cavity may push the cold clouds outward, though their eventual fate is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The jet's path through thin gas is also worth following, but the cold clouds relate more directly to the remaining goal.

effect: The expanding flow carries some dense clouds outward while their interiors remain cold; their eventual fate is still unclear.
reaction: The cold clouds surviving within a hot outflow are an interesting contrast.
reason: Following the clouds into the outer reaches directly addresses whether they are lost to the galaxy.
expectation: The clouds may slow and eventually return, though they could instead disperse or escape.

alternatives.reason: The surrounding gas may also affect the clouds, but their destination seems more directly relevant.

effect: The cold clouds did not escape; they slow and return toward the centre, completing the remaining goal.
reaction: Their outward journey becoming a later inward flow was a satisfying conclusion.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the broken cloud into a wide hot cavity made the jet's large-scale effect clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Carrying the cold clouds outward was a fairly predictable intermediate step, though it set up their eventual return.

surprise.text: Dense cloud interiors could remain cold while being carried by the hot expanding flow.

arbitrary.text: No chosen action felt particularly arbitrary; each followed the disturbance or the clouds' fate.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested in seeing what the returning cold clouds do next, although the fast menu made the combinations less about discovering compatibility.
